kjv: The thing is gone from me
mine: The word from me is firm
note: azda is a Persian loanword meaning "certain/publicly decreed"; the king has not forgotten his dream but is testing the diviners, which KJV's rendering (implying he forgot it) obscures; also at 2:8.

kjv: they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men
mine: they will mix with one another in marriage
note: bizra anasha "by the seed of men" is usually taken of dynastic intermarriage; KJV's literal phrase has fed speculative readings.
